activation: A later explicitly authorized qualification campaign; these IDs are document obligations, not imported active tasks.

obligations.title: Exactness, contracts and safety
obligations.scope: Complete required general CPU/CUDA semantics, differential/adversarial tests, stable/unordered output guarantees, relevant sanitizers and public API audit.

obligations.title: Performance and policy selection
obligations.scope: Measure end-to-end costs including packing, directory building, replay, bytes and information loss. Select executors from real workloads; preserve failures.

obligations.title: Production stack interfaces
obligations.scope: Inspect current Cellerator ABI/runtime/operator ownership, then design producer-owned adapter handoffs and optional Torch views without binding obsolete DeviceMathContext.

obligations.title: Learned biological evaluation
obligations.scope: Choose an explicit sequence-to-target objective, split by appropriate biological units, compare fixed/local/dense/learned baselines and investigate leakage, non-identifiability and counterfactual limits.

obligations.title: Distribution and persistent reuse
obligations.scope: Only after concrete need, request Cellerator partition and CellShard persistence integration through their separate authorities; account for communication and invalidation.
